definitions.explanation: A person who works in the entertainment industry, including actors, comedians, singers, and TV personalities. Broader than 'actor' or 'singer' — covers anyone in show business.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{芸能人|げいのうじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{芸能人|げいのうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{私生活|しせいかつ}→私生活：15112_shiseikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週刊誌|しゅうかんし}→週刊誌：11179_shuukanshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げられる→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧。
examples.english: Celebrities' private lives are often covered by tabloid magazines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{芸能人|げいのうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れて→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧、{高校卒業|こうこうそつぎょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{芸能事務所|げいのうじむしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Having admired entertainers since childhood, I joined a talent agency right after graduating high school.

notes:
A catch-all term for people in the entertainment industry. Unlike English 'celebrity,' which emphasizes fame, {芸能人|げいのうじん} emphasizes the profession of entertaining.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸能人|げいのうじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a celebrity)
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{芸能人|げいのうじん} (popular celebrity)
- {芸能人|げいのうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{私生活|しせいかつ}→私生活：15112_shiseikatsu⟧ (celebrity's private life)
- {芸能事務所|げいのうじむしょ} (talent agency)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦タレント→タレント：25367_tarento⟧ focuses on TV personalities specifically
- ⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧ means 'famous person' regardless of profession
- ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧ is specifically an actor
